text: GitHub Contents is the availability ledger (repo=chain, branch=lane, blob SHA=object, tree=Merkle dir, Actions=plugins). CODE lane = main + Railway disk. STATE lane = bot-state (vita-registry.json, ledger). Base leftover hitch + /prove is settlement — never invent tx hashes. Telegram /vita read failed because githubGet always hit bot-state and JSON.parsed .js files. Fix: local disk first, then CODE, then STATE, UTF-8 decode, SNARK-short unwrap with Railway-style session keys (permanent / ttl / destroy-on-unwrap). IDM chat = Basescan Input Data → UTF-8 of batched sealed locs. Anthropic not required to open a file.

hypothesis.note: Click-through Telegram + HTML /vita/read works out of the box from Railway checkout. State files still need bot-state Contents API. Session keys are open-source content commitments, not wallet secrets.
